public class Main {

    public void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long W = sc.nextLong();
        long M = sc.nextLong();

        int cur = 0;
        while (Math.pow(W, cur) < M) {
            cur++;
        }
        double pw = Math.pow(W, cur);

        if (pw == M) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        long max = (long) pw;
        long sum = (max - 1) / (W - 1);
        if (max - sum == M) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        System.out.println(dfs(W, M) ? "YES" : "NO");
    }

    private boolean dfs(long W, long M) {
        while (M != 1) {
            if (M % W == 0) {
                M /= W;
            } else if ((M - 1) % W == 0) {
                M = (M - 1) / W;
            } else if ((M + 1) % W == 0) {
                M = (M + 1) / W;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().solve();
    }
}
